error_handling.overview: Error scenarios and recovery procedures for Visual Auditor mode. These cover unreadable screenshots, missing evidence, conflicting readings, and handoff failures.

scenario.name: unreadable_screenshot
scenario.description: The screenshot cannot be interpreted (blank, black, truncated, or corrupt)

symptoms.symptom: Image contains no rendered page content
Image is black, blank, or partially truncated
Vision model cannot identify any elements

step.action: Verify the screenshot file is valid
step.code: Check file size is non-zero and the image opens correctly.

step.action: Mark INVESTIGATE with the specific reason
step.code: Record the check as INVESTIGATE and state why (blank/black/truncated/corrupt).

step.action: Request a fresh capture from the gathering mode
step.code: Hand back to visual-debug mode requesting a new screenshot with correct framing and viewport.

scenario.name: missing_intended_values
scenario.description: The intended design values are not supplied for comparison

symptoms.symptom: No expected CSS/design values provided with the screenshots
No expected behavior description for feature completion checks

step.action: Record INVESTIGATE for checks that require intended values
step.code: Without a reference, mark the comparison checks as INVESTIGATE.

step.action: Request the intended values from the gathering mode
step.code: Ask for the expected design values or behavior so comparisons can be completed.

scenario.name: conflicting_evidence
scenario.description: Vision reading conflicts with programmatic evidence

symptoms.symptom: Visual observation differs from computed-style or contrast data
Contrast ratio says PASS but the screenshot appears unreadable

step.action: Re-examine both the screenshot and the programmatic data
step.code: Re-read the screenshot carefully and re-check the computed values for accuracy (element mismatch, wrong selector, opacity effect).
If the discrepancy is resolved (e.g., opacity reduces effective contrast), report the corrected verdict. Otherwise mark INVESTIGATE and note the conflicting evidence.

scenario.name: vision_model_unavailable
scenario.description: The vision-capable model is unavailable or degraded

symptoms.symptom: The model cannot accept or interpret image content
Vision analysis is inaccurate or hallucinated

step.action: Confirm the vision model is selected and reachable
step.code: Verify the model (qwen3.6-abliterated / qwen3-vl) is available.

step.action: Document the limitation and fall back
step.code: Record in evidence.md that visual verification was unavailable and rely on programmatic evidence from the gathering mode, clearly labeled as a fallback.

protocol.name: evidence_resume
protocol.description: Resume an interrupted audit from evidence.md

steps.step: 1. Read evidence.md for the audit state
2. Identify which screenshots still lack a verdict
3. Re-open those screenshots and record verdicts
4. Update evidence.md with the completed checks

protocol.name: fresh_capture
protocol.description: Request and use a fresh screenshot capture

steps.step: 1. Identify the specific screenshot that is unreadable
2. Hand back to visual-debug with the reason and desired framing
3. On receipt of the fresh capture, re-run the affected checks
4. Record both the old and new paths in evidence.md
